description: Land Acquisition - Getamanna, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal/regulatory frameworks, commercial matters, or other specialized categories present - the entire document focuses solely on land-related administrative procedures.
